'''''Carex otrubae''''', the '''false fox-sedge''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the sedge family, [[Cyperaceae]].

==Description==
It grows {{convert|40|-|70|cm}} tall with the leaves being linear and {{convert|3|-|7|mm}} wide. Both [[inflorescence]] and [[lanceolate]] are {{convert|5|cm}} long. Its [[Achene|utricle]]s are either pale green or orange-brown. Female specimens have pale orange-brown [[glume]]s which are ovate and are {{convert|3|mm}} in length.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=242101074|title=''Carex otrubae'' |publisher=Flora of China|accessdate=May 13, 2013}}</ref>

==Distribution and habitat==
This species occurs in [[Europe]], [[Central Asia]], [[West Siberian Plain|West Siberia]], and [[Xinjiang]], [[China]]. It thrives in wetlands on heavy soils and especially in lowland areas and can be found near lakes, rivers and reservoirs, as well as coastal areas.<ref>[https://www.naturespot.org.uk/species/false-fox-sedge NatureSpot - False Fox Sedge]</ref>
